title: Answer: space is the mesh of docks, read on its flat 3d husk

statements.text: Space is the mesh of docks, in the model the four-dimensional hyperbolic honeycomb $\lbrace3,4,3,4\rbrace$, each dock a 24-cell with 24 slots. The space physics is read in is the husk, the flat 3d surface of the mesh at a cusp, where a spectral dimension near 3 is read (E-GMT-0025). Nothing moves through space: each beat a slot takes its neighbor's value along its direction. The experiments run on a flat periodic D4 box with the same 24 directions per dock, a disclosed stand-in for the honeycomb.
statements.scope: the honeycomb is a committed choice. The experiments run on its D4 stand-in, not on $\lbrace3,4,3,4\rbrace$ itself
